text_block_list.text:
I thought the lights were still on... 
Looks like Madam President is busy as can 
be.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiiya, Rudolf. Working hard so late into 
the night, babe♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was just finalizing the paperwork 
for the upcoming student mixer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A mixer bridging across generations is a 
prime opportunity for students to broaden 
their horizons... I must maintain absolute 
diligence.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. How you push yourself way too hard 
for the sake of the horse girls... hasn't 
changed one bit.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Really, you haven't changed at all since 
way back when. ...Just like that time you 
took me out all the way to the Symboli 
estate, remember?♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That was before I became Student 
Council President, was it not—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Here we are. This is the training course 
owned by the Symboli family.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wish to train with you here today. With 
single-minded focus—until we are both 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This is totally legit~! It's so fully 
equipped, you could hold a real race here 
no problem!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, the ground laid out here... Is this 
gravel? What an unusual course!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By running while maintaining balance, one 
trains muscles not normally engaged... It 
is a course conceived by the Symboli 
household.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We also have courses prepared that do not 
exist at Tracen Academy. I hope they meet 
your approval.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! That gets my engine 
revving! Alright—I'm gonna burn up the 
track to my heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... I can really feel that I used 
every single muscle. It felt like giving 
it my all with zero holding back—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My heart was racing, it was the absolute 
best! Thanks a bunch♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...No. It is I who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, these courses you ran on... 
all of them are state-of-the-art training 
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And you ran every single one to 
completion. Thanks to that, the areas 
needing improvement have become clear.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm~...? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I wish to further improve Tracen 
Academy's training facilities.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The horse girls of our academy train 
relentlessly every day in pursuit of 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to provide the ultimate environment 
where those horse girls can aim for even 
greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone can lead a glorious 
racing career... free of regrets and 
lingering attachments.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I currently hold no such 
authority. I am merely speaking of pipe 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...However, a path to make that dream a 
reality—does exist.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
! Hehe... If it's you, I bet you'll run 
that path all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And now, here you are as the proper 
Student Council President. A lot of things 
have changed regarding your standing, but—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Those resolute eyes of yours... they 
haven't changed one bit♪

Between classes, while walking through the 
academy grounds, I spotted Symboli Rudolf 
handling what looked like Student Council 
duties.

time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The student mixer draws near, 
after all. I must treasure every spare 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To make this exchange event a beacon of 
hope for everyone... That is my sole duty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall devote everything I have so as not 
to bring shame upon the title of Student 
Council President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is reassuring. ...However, this is 
student council business.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, leave it to me. As the leader of 
the student council, I shall see it 
through.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I appreciate your concern. I shall 
take care not to overexert myself.
